purpose: Claim-level source, limitation, and visual-evidence map for the ORVYQ deep-sea-mining documentary.

status_policy.verified: The claim is supportable from the listed primary, official, intergovernmental or peer-reviewed source.
status_policy.attributed_commentary: The statement may remain only when clearly attributed in narration and on screen.
status_policy.rewrite_required: The wording is too strong or insufficiently sourced; Candidate Validation must fail until rewritten.
status_policy.source_required: A primary or authoritative source and visual evidence asset must be added before use.

source_catalog.limitation: Technical operation does not establish commercial viability, reserve scale or acceptable environmental impact.

source_catalog.limitation: Scenario analysis varies with technology, policy, prices and project delivery.

sections.title: The mud that reached daylight
sections.dramatic_function: Open on Japan's 2026 technical milestone and reveal the supply-chain motive.

sections.title: The chokepoint
sections.dramatic_function: Explain why refining and magnet concentration make the ocean strategically valuable.

sections.title: The black map
sections.dramatic_function: Move from Japan's EEZ to polymetallic nodules in the Clarion–Clipperton Zone.

sections.title: Two rulebooks
sections.dramatic_function: Show the unfinished ISA code and the parallel United States route without overstating permit status.

sections.title: The argument for mining
sections.dramatic_function: Present the strongest case for extraction, then separate mineral need from supply-chain control.

sections.title: What the machine leaves behind
sections.dramatic_function: Ground environmental uncertainty in measured track, plume and midwater evidence.

sections.title: The precedent
sections.dramatic_function: Resolve the film around governance, distribution of risk and irreversible precedent.

claims.narration_excerpt: But it proved that material could be lifted continuously from more than five kilometres below the Pacific.
evidence_requirements: Show Chikyu and the official 5,569-metre figure.
State that technical recovery is not commercial viability.

claims.narration_excerpt: In 2024, China produced about sixty percent of the world’s magnet rare earths.
evidence_requirements: Show 60% mining, 91% refining and 94% sintered permanent-magnet production with 2024 scope.
Do not generalise the percentages to all rare earths.

claims.narration_excerpt: In 2025, Chinese export controls turned that concentration into a physical problem.
evidence_requirements: Use dated export-control and disruption evidence.
Do not imply a permanent total cutoff.

claims.narration_excerpt: A larger production-chain trial is planned for 2027, followed by technical and economic assessment.
evidence_requirements: Show the planned 2027 trial and 2028 assessment as future milestones.
Do not present the schedule as guaranteed.

claims.narration_excerpt: Under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, the seabed beyond national jurisdiction is described as the common heritage of mankind.
evidence_requirements: Show Articles 136 and 137 at readable size.
Distinguish the Area from national EEZ projects.

claims.narration_excerpt: As of July 24, 2026, the Authority had still not completed the regulations intended to govern exploitation.
evidence_requirements: Show Revision 3, the outstanding-issues list and the July 24 roadmap agenda.
Date-lock the statement to July 24, 2026.

claims.narration_excerpt: The United States has not ratified the Law of the Sea Convention.
evidence_requirements: Show the domestic DSHMRA route and the executive order separately.
Do not state that U.S. policy settles the international-law dispute.

claims.narration_excerpt: But no United States commercial recovery permit had been issued.
evidence_requirements: Show NOAA's current 'N/A' commercial-permit entry and application status.
An application or certification must never be labelled approval.

claims.narration_excerpt: From that perspective, collecting nodules from an uninhabited abyssal plain could appear less destructive than opening new mines on land.
evidence_requirements: Attribute lifecycle claims to proponents or the company.
Pair the claim with independent ecological limitations.

claims.narration_excerpt: But the phrase “we need deep-sea mining for the energy transition” is too simple.
evidence_requirements: Show chemistry-specific demand differences and scenario uncertainty.
Do not claim that any mineral is categorically unnecessary.

claims.narration_excerpt: And for rare earths, the most important bottleneck may not be the mine.
evidence_requirements: Show the mine-to-refining-to-magnet chain.
Present 'may' as supply-chain analysis, not a universal law.

claims.narration_excerpt: Forty-four years later, the physical disturbance was still visible.
evidence_requirements: Show real comparison images and the 44-year interval.
State that some recolonisation occurred and that the historical test was small.

claims.narration_excerpt: Two months after the test, macrofaunal density inside the mining tracks was thirty-seven percent lower.
evidence_requirements: Show 37% density and 32% richness findings inside tracks.
Distinguish direct-track effects from plume-area community changes and retain the two-month limit.

claims.narration_excerpt: Measurements from collector trials show that disturbed sediment can travel kilometres.
evidence_requirements: Show measured plume distance, near-bottom concentration and decline with distance/height/time.
Reject both 'strictly local' and 'whole-ocean poisoning' simplifications.

claims.narration_excerpt: Research suggests those discharge particles may be nutritionally poor compared with the particles many midwater organisms normally consume.
evidence_requirements: Show the food-web and particle-quality mechanism.
State that this is plausible risk, not observed commercial-scale collapse.

claims.narration_excerpt: The strongest case for moving ahead is not that the damage will be harmless.
evidence_requirements: Treat this as the film's balanced synthesis of the verified environmental and supply-security record.
Do not present either uncertainty or national-security risk as a measured universal conclusion.

claims.narration_excerpt: There is another possibility.
evidence_requirements: Treat the unused-option argument as synthesis built from the film's already-cited technical, market and governance evidence.
Do not imply that any specific project is certain to fail, proceed or deter another state.

claims.narration_excerpt: The ability to reach a resource does not create an obligation to extract it.
evidence_requirements: Present the distinction between capability, strategic option and extraction decision as editorial synthesis.
Build the recap only from earlier verified technology, supply-chain and governance evidence.

claims.narration_excerpt: The deep ocean may carry damage that cannot be seen from shore.
evidence_requirements: Treat the distribution of risk across communities, industry, states and ecosystems as the film's synthesis.
Do not convert this synthesis into a quantified comparison not established by the cited sources.

claims.narration_excerpt: And future generations may inherit the precedent.
evidence_requirements: Treat the ending as a recap of the film's verified technical, scientific and legal record rather than a new factual claim.
Keep the future programme, application and negotiation language conditional and date-aware.
